metadata.purpose: Machine-auditable binding amendments that sit alongside the governed numbered Sections 0-121 without changing the 122-section count.
metadata.source: NOVAPHARM EXECUTIVE PLATFORM — consolidated post-PR-16 mandate
metadata.reconciliation_basis: Evidence paths and state invariants are validated against the exact repository checkout running requirements:validate; no static SHA is used as a claim of perpetual currency.

amendments.title: APPLE-GRADE WEB ENGINEERING, SOURCE-CODE, FORMAT, ART-DIRECTION & FOUNDER-MIND OVERRIDE
amendments.scope: All 0A.x clauses remain binding, including evidence-not-mythology Apple reference rules, authored source code, semantic HTML, CSS-first motion, responsive engineering, visual rejection loops, real-device review and Swift/Wasm evidence gates.
amendments.remaining_gate: Managed-staging/live evidence and owner-controlled real Apple hardware review remain required where the underlying clause demands them. Current official Apple/WebKit/Swift evidence must be re-checked at execution time; private Apple implementation remains unknown.

amendments.title: POST-PR-16 MERGE — AUTHORITATIVE REALITY OVERRIDE
amendments.scope: Live Git/GitHub and infrastructure reality override obsolete branch assumptions; PR 16 is historical merged baseline evidence rather than an active feature branch.
amendments.remaining_gate: Remain bound to current repository/deployment reality on every continuation change.

amendments.title: REPAIR THE PUBLIC LINK-VALIDATION CONTRACT
amendments.remaining_gate: Keep public artifact and internal workbench validation scopes explicit.

amendments.title: EXPLICIT DEPLOYMENT / RELEASE MODE CONTRACT
amendments.remaining_gate: Do not promote mode/state without its named evidence.

amendments.title: BACKEND-LIVE VERIFICATION MUST ONLY GATE A BACKEND-LIVE RELEASE
amendments.remaining_gate: Backend-live verification remains explicit and SHA-bound when backend activation is actually attempted.

amendments.title: NO DANGLING GITHUB RELEASE STATUS
amendments.remaining_gate: Every release status writer must preserve terminal success/failure behavior.

amendments.title: FIX-FORWARD PR ACCEPTANCE
amendments.remaining_gate: Continuation PRs remain small, exact-SHA tested and evidence-driven.

amendments.title: SOURCE-CONTROL MERGE BOUNDARY
amendments.remaining_gate: A merge may be production-relevant; merge only tested/authorized changes and retain separate production cutover gates.

amendments.title: DEPENDENCY FREEZE DURING RELEASE REPAIR
amendments.remaining_gate: Future dependency changes must earn their place independently; no broad churn is inherited from the repair phase.

amendments.title: POST-REPAIR PUBLIC BASELINE
amendments.remaining_gate: R1 public baseline remains distinct from managed staging and production.

amendments.title: RELEASE STATE MACHINE
amendments.remaining_gate: R2-R6 remain unavailable until their explicit evidence gates are satisfied.

amendments.title: POST-MERGE PRIORITY OVERRIDE
amendments.remaining_gate: Continue the mandated sequence: truthful repository baseline, justified language choices, Portal/forms, staging, real identity/data/integrations, all modules, security/monitoring/recovery, executable procedures, cutover readiness, controlled production, monitoring, then R6 evidence.
